help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Frequently asked questions
help.faq1q: How do I log a practice?
help.faq1a: Go to the Home tab and find your practice card. Each card shows the input for that day. Changes save automatically.
help.faq2a: A Yatra is a group practice circle. Members track practices together and hold each other accountable.
help.faq3q: How do I share a chart?
help.faq3a: Go to Charts and tap the Share button in the page header. A public link is copied to your clipboard.
help.faq4q: Can I use the app offline?
help.faq4a: Yes. The app loads cached data when offline. Changes queue automatically and sync when connectivity returns.
help.faq5a: Go to Settings → Import data. Upload a CSV file, map the columns to your practices, then confirm.
help.faq6q: How do I change my language?
help.faq6a: Go to Settings → Language and select English, Русский, or Українська.
help.faq7q: How do I add a new practice?
help.faq7a: Go to Settings → My practices and tap the + button, or tap the + FAB on the Home tab.
help.faq8q: How do I reorder my practices?
help.faq8a: Go to Settings → My practices and drag the handle on the left of each row.
